root_cause_analysis.primary_cause: Inconsistent native launch resource resolution and unconstrained system brightness overriding application theme preference.
root_cause_analysis.native_layer_flaw: values-night/styles.xml referenced Theme.Black.NoTitleBar and values-night/launch_color.xml was configured to #0D0C13. Whenever the phone OS had dark mode enabled, Android automatically drew a dark window before Flutter engine initialized, followed by Flutter rendering in its default light mode (#FFFFFF), producing a jarring dark-to-light flash.
root_cause_analysis.flutter_theme_mode_flaw: ThemeMode.system was previously permitted as an intermediate fallback, causing Android OS brightness changes to alter the application appearance regardless of user selection.
root_cause_analysis.ambient_canvas_flaw: AppScaffold.buildLiquidAmbientCanvas() defaulted to isDark = true when called without BuildContext, rendering dark glowing orbs (indigo, violet, emerald) across light theme screens.

native_launch_unification.changes: Unified launch_bg_color to #FFFFFF across standard and night values; set LaunchTheme parent to Theme.Light.NoTitleBar with android:forceDarkAllowed='false'. Cold start is always pure white matching Image 2.

dynamic_main_activity_window_styling.changes: Inspects FlutterSharedPreferences on process creation; immediately matches window, status bar, and navigation bar to #0D0C13 if dark mode was explicitly saved, avoiding any light flash.

authoritative_theme_controller.changes: Removed ThemeMode.system. Supported states are strictly ThemeMode.light and ThemeMode.dark with deterministic light default. Suppressed redundant notifyListeners() calls.

zero_flash_startup_restoration.changes: Synchronously queries AppPreferencesService.getThemeMode() prior to runApp(); passes resolved initialThemeMode to ThemeService and MaterialApp.

ambient_canvas_theme_fidelity.changes: Changed default isDark fallback in buildLiquidAmbientCanvas to false (light mode); updated all calling screens to explicitly supply context.

test_a_fresh_installation_light_default.details: When no preference exists or preference is light, cold process starts with white #FFFFFF background, Flutter splash renders white with Image 2, and student dashboard displays in light theme. Zero dark frame appears.

test_b_dark_theme_persistence.details: User selects dark theme ('Obsidian Abyss'); whole UI switches to dark theme; persists across navigation tabs; persists across complete app restart.

test_c_light_theme_persistence.details: User switches back to light theme ('Warm Light'); whole UI switches to light theme; persists across navigation tabs; persists across complete app restart.

test_d_system_appearance_independence.details: Toggled Android OS uimode night between 'yes' and 'no' via ADB; verified app UI remained in explicit user-selected light theme with zero flickering or unwanted theme inversion.

test_e_startup_and_authentication.details: Tested authenticated startup with student session (ABISHEK A, Roll: 721025149002); verified theme preloading eliminates intermediate frames; session and data 100% preserved.
